title: AATIP study of 260,000 cases and a possible existential threat

tellings.quote: And the the AATIP program looked at 260,000 different cases with seven levels of analysis. This is probably the biggest study of UFO data ever. And one of the conclusions that Vallée hints at two or three times in the journals is that you know, an existential threat may have been detected.

plain: Jason Simosa, a researcher, says that between about 2007 and 2013 a government UFO study, run through the Defense Intelligence Agency, a military spy agency, and Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company, looked at 260,000 cases with seven levels of analysis, which he calls probably the biggest study of UFO data ever. He says that Jacques Vallee, a longtime UFO researcher, hints two or three times in his private journals that one conclusion was that an existential threat to humanity may have been detected.
